# UP Dietitian

> UP Dietitian is a sports dietitian practice in Perth, Western Australia, led by Lauren Nash, an Accredited Practising Dietitian (APD). Lauren helps everyday to elite athletes and active people with performance nutrition, race fuelling, gut issues during exercise, body composition, weight-category sport, injury recovery and coeliac disease. Consultations are in person at Front Runner Physiotherapy, 2/16 Baden Street, Osborne Park WA 6017, or online via Zoom Australia-wide and internationally. Private health rebates are available with participating funds. No GP referral is needed.

Contact: hello@updietitian.com · Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/up_dietitian/ · Free 15-minute discovery call: https://calendly.com/updietitian/15min
